messages.subject: Difficulties regarding Part 4
messages.body_plain:
Hi all,

I am trying to analyse the data from GENEActiv accelerometers, which my institute bought to further examine sleep in bipolar disease.
Some of my colleagues and me wore those accelerometers to get some data (3-4 days) to find a scheme of analysis.

Unfortunately I have some difficulties understanding and solving some of the problems, that occurred.

To get started I used the Shell-function of GGIR.
If I don't enter any sleeplog data at "loglocation" and just use the function def.noc.sleep the following error occurs:

Error in g.shell.GGIR(mode = c(1, 2, 3, 4, 5), datadir = "C:/Users/Administrator/Documents/TR2018.csv",  :
  argument is missing, with no Default

I then tried many different things and - among others - wrote a rudimentary sleep log as suggested in the GGIR Vignette. Using this sleeplog the following error occurs:

Error in `[.data.frame`(S, , coln1 + ((i - 1) * 2)) : undefined columns selected

R stops processing after part 4 both times.

As you might have noticed I'm neither very familiar with R in general nor with GGIR in particular. So I would be really glad if some of you could help me understanding my mistakes and overcoming at least some of them.

Kind regards,
Tom

messages.subject: Re: [GGIR] error when processing shorter days data from Geneactive actigraph
messages.subject_clean: [GGIR] error when processing shorter days data from Geneactive actigraph
messages.body_plain:
Hi Leona,
Argument includedaycrit = 16,
means that you only keep days with at least 16 hours of valid data (sensor worn), which will be unrealistic if you only collect two half days of data. Lowering the threshold should give you a report per day (calendar day). Also you may want to checkout argument dayborder. See GGIR package documentation for further clarification.
Best, Vincent
